rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: gs_n_iter=500, gs_n_gaussians=256, gs_outer_wall_s=1500, gs_lr_pos=0.0005, train_n=2, val_n=2, rationale=iter-8: KNOB=gs_lr_pos: 1e-3→5e-4 (half). iter-6 (500i/lr=1e-3) hr=0.0335 BEST; iter-7 (800i) regressed to 0.0275. Hypothesis: 500i is the sweet density-iter combo; halve gs_lr_pos to let each step do less but more accurately — may produce smoother convergence and beat 0.0335.
